name: Stateless Parallel Volume Rendering Communication Protocol
definition: A distributed rendering architecture where processing nodes (Nodos Procesadores) hold a full copy of the volume in local GPU memory and do not store internal state. Synchronization is achieved via multicast control packets containing counters, while output is sent via unicast to integration nodes (Nodos Integrador).
summary: The Stateless Parallel Volume Rendering Communication Protocol is a distributed, best-effort system that decouples computation from state management to solve synchronization bottlenecks in real-time volume rendering.
